feature_01.title: Home Renovations — Transform your existing space into a home that works better for you.
feature_01.desc: Whether preserving the soul of a classic New Zealand villa or modernizing a multi-level suburban build, we orchestrate the entire renovation lifecycle with structural certitude.
bullets: Full council consent handling, architectural liaison, and engineering sign-offs.

Custom stone vanities fabricated and installed to exact spatial requirements.

pillars.title: Why Homeowners Trust NS Building
pillars.subtitle: We eliminate the stress, guesswork, and friction often associated with domestic renovations.

items.title: Local NZ Experience
items.desc: Deep technical fluency with the New Zealand Building Code (E2 weather-tightness, NZS 3604 timber framing), council compliance, and historic Kiwi architecture.

items.title: Quality Workmanship
items.desc: Licensed Building Practitioners (LBP) obsessed with millimetric tolerances. We reject shortcuts and exclusively install proven, premium building materials.

items.title: Clear Communication
items.desc: Comprehensive itemized quote scopes, scheduled weekly site updates, and total transparency. No unexpected budget blowouts or hidden fees.

items.title: Reliable & Punctual
items.desc: Clean, vacuumed job sites at the close of every day. Respectful, fully vetted Kiwi trade crews that honor scheduled milestone completion dates.

items.name: Mark & Sarah T.
items.review: NS Building transformed our dated 1970s bungalow in Grey Lynn into an architectural dream. Communication was flawless throughout, and their attention to joinery alignment was second to none.

items.name: David L.
items.review: The bathroom renovation was completed on schedule with exceptional attention to waterproof details and stone tile cuts. The crew was polite, tidy, and genuinely respectful of our family home.

items.name: Ngaire W.
items.review: Professional, honest, and meticulous. When unforeseen foundation leveling issues popped up, they had engineered solutions ready within the morning. Couldn't recommend them higher.
